questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the correct reported speech form: 'I really enjoyed the exhibition,' she said to me.
options: She said that she had really enjoyed the exhibition.
She said that she had really enjoyed the exhibition.
She said that she had really enjoyed the exhibition.
She said that she had really enjoyed the exhibition.
questions.answer: She said that she had really enjoyed the exhibition.

questions.question: Which option correctly reports the following statement: 'If I find the time, I will definitely visit Paris before the end of the year.'
options: He said that if he found the time, he would definitely visit Paris before the end of the year.
He said that if he found the time, he would definitely visit Paris before the end of the year.
He said that if he found the time, he would definitely visit Paris before the end of the year.
He said that if he found the time, he would definitely visit Paris before the end of the year.
questions.answer: He said that if he found the time, he would definitely visit Paris before the end of the year.
